settings.title: How to use it?
settings.content:
1. Preparation: Cleanse the client's skin thoroughly.
  2. Product Application: Dip the silicone brush into the desired conductive gel or serum.
  3. Application: Gently apply the product to the face or body using smooth, upward strokes.
  4. Post-Use Care: Clean the brush with mild soap and warm water; allow it to air dry before the next use.Amazon+1Amazon+1

settings.title: Benefits
settings.content:
• Hygienic Application: Reduces direct hand contact, minimizing cross-contamination risks.
  • Product Efficiency: Ensures even distribution of gels and serums, preventing waste.
  • Client Comfort: Soft, non-irritating bristles provide a soothing experience.
  • Easy Maintenance: Silicone material is simple to clean and sanitize between uses.
  • Durable Design: Built to withstand frequent use in a professional setting.

settings.title: Product Features
settings.content:
• Material: High-quality, reusable silicone head with a durable plastic handle.
  • Design: Ergonomically shaped to contour to the face, ensuring precise application.
  • Compatibility: Ideal for use with MyoLift™ conductive gels and other facial products.
  • Sustainability: OEKO-TEX certified, ensuring safe manufacturing practices.
  • Dimensions: Compact size suitable for both facial and body applications.
